sources.quote: SUP-C,Meccanica Chisone S.r.l.,aluminium extrusions and blanks
Correct, the audit qualifies the company. Part approvals stay as they are.

findings.why: Chisone is approved as a company again, so there is no supplier-standing finding. The re-audit does not release any part. No controlled record gives Chisone an approval for PN-050 for a receiving plant or customer. The documents do not name PN-050's customer or plant. Chisone's listed commodity is aluminium extrusions and blanks, not pins. Absence of a record is not proof of non-approval, so someone must confirm whether a PN-050 release exists.
